contentList.content: Once per Short Rest, as a free action, you can quicken your magic: the next spell you cast this turn that costs an action costs a bonus action instead.
The next spell you cast this turn that costs an action costs a bonus action instead.

While toggled on, you ignore the One Spell with a Spell Slot per Turn rule and can cast more than one spell that uses a spell slot on your turn. If you have the Swift Witchcraft feat, its action becomes a free Quickened Spell once per Short Rest. (Val's DnD AIO Beyond Patch)

While toggled on, short rests restore hit points as in the base game instead of healing 1 hit point and unlocking Use Hit Point Dice. Hit Point Dice are still spent by the features that use them. (Val's DnD AIO Beyond Patch)
